entries.title: Credit risk monitoring non-compete for RBI Regulated Lenders in India
entries.summary: AtliQ and its Affiliates may not design, develop, deploy, license, or provide any credit early-warning, delinquency-prediction, or credit-risk monitoring model or service to any RBI or NHB Regulated Lender in India during the 24-month Cooling-off Period following Final Acceptance.
entries.quote: Without limiting Clause 10.1, for a period of twenty-four (24) months from the date of Final Acceptance (the "Cooling-off Period"), the Service Provider shall not, and shall ensure that its Affiliates shall not, design, develop, deploy, license or provide any credit early-warning, delinquency-prediction or similar credit-risk monitoring model or service to any Regulated Lender in India, whether or not derived from the Lumen EWS Model.

relatedClauses.quote: "Final Acceptance" means the Bank's written acceptance of Milestone M4 under SOW-1.

"Regulated Lender" means any bank, small finance bank, cooperative bank, non-banking financial company, housing finance company or other lender regulated by the Reserve Bank of India or the National Housing Bank.

The Bank may waive Clause 10.2 in writing for a specific engagement. Any request shall be made at least thirty (30) days before the Service Provider submits a proposal to the relevant Regulated Lender.
| M4 | Production deployment, dashboards (Final Acceptance) | 23,40,000 | 31 Jul 2026 |

entries.endRule: 24 months from Final Acceptance (M4 target date: 31 July 2026)
entries.notes: The Cooling-off Period of 24 months starts on the date of Final Acceptance (Milestone M4 target date is 31 July 2026, resulting in an estimated end date of 31 July 2028). Clause 10.3 sets out a written waiver process 30 days prior to proposal submission.

entries.title: India data localisation and offshore access restriction
entries.summary: AtliQ must store and process all Bank data, customer data, loan data, and derived data sets exclusively within India, and prohibits access to Bank data from outside India (including by Affiliates) without prior written approval.
entries.quote: All Bank data, including customer and loan data and any derived data sets, shall be stored and processed exclusively within India. No Bank data shall be accessed from outside India, including by any Affiliate of the Service Provider, without the Bank's prior written approval.

entries.title: RBI outsourcing compliance and audit rights
entries.summary: AtliQ must comply with RBI IT outsourcing requirements and grant inspection and audit rights over its premises, systems, and records to the Bank, its auditors, and the Reserve Bank of India.
entries.quote: The Service Provider acknowledges that the Services constitute outsourcing of financial services under the RBI Master Direction on Outsourcing of Information Technology Services and agrees to comply with all requirements notified by the Bank. The Bank, its auditors and the Reserve Bank of India shall have the right to inspect and audit the Service Provider's premises, systems and records relating to the Services on reasonable notice.

entries.title: Restriction on use of Bank data and EWS Model for other clients
entries.summary: AtliQ must not use the Bank's data, the Lumen EWS Model, or any part of it for any other client.
entries.quote: The Service Provider shall not use the Bank's data, the Lumen EWS Model or any part of it for any other client.
